metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Tapfold Journeys (travel booking); Platform: on-premises data center DC-South, server range 172.19.0.0/16; Two data centers DC-A and DC-B linked by routed interconnects with a stretched VLAN 50; legacy PostgreSQL primary/standby pair (db-a in DC-A, db-b in DC-B) behind a keepalived VRRP virtual IP 172.19.217.85 with a promote-on-MASTER script; network automation: Ansible AWX pushes router ACLs (job IDs AWX-); Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
investigation_questions: What change, deployment or automation run triggered the incident? Provide its change identifier.
Which account or automation identity executed the triggering change?
Which network device dropped the database heartbeat and replication traffic?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which change happened shortly before the incident began but did not cause it? Provide its identifier.
Which change mitigated the incident? Provide its change identifier.

artifacts.content: {"description": "Application and proxy error logs: HTTP/gRPC status codes, failing requests (caller -> callee:port : operation), error messages and the services emitting them.", "facts": ["error events: 7587 matching events", "error events > status codes: 409 \u2014 7534 events", "error events > status codes: 500 \u2014 53 events", "failing requests: reconciliation-job -> db-a / db-b : compare ledgers \u2014 5475 events", "failing requests: loyalty-api -> 172.19.217.85:5432 : INSERT \u2014 2059 events", "failing requests: nightly-batch -> 172.19.217.85:5432 : SELECT totals \u2014 32 events", "failing requests: checkin-api -> checkin-db:5432 : query \u2014 21 events", "error messages: conflict: record version mismatch between DC-A and DC-B \u2014 5475 events", "error messages: duplicate key value violates unique constraint (sequence collision after promotion) \u2014 2059 events", "error messages: checksum mismatch for nightly batch \u2014 32 events", "error messages: pq: could not serialize access due to concurrent update \u2014 21 events", "emitting services: reconciliation-job \u2014 5475 events", "emitting services: loyalty-api \u2014 2059 events", "emitting services: nightly-batch \u2014 32 events", "emitting services: checkin-api \u2014 21 events"]}
